name: No mutation: stuck at the first good tour
lesson: Crossover only reshuffles the cities already in the population, so without mutation the search soon runs out of new tours and stops improving.
lookFor: Same instance, seed and starting population as “berlin52: the nearest neighbour and the optimum”. With mutation off, nothing improves after generation 49: the best tour stays 154.2 % over the optimum, at 19,173. The stagnation window is 50 in this preset, so Run until stop pauses at generation 99. Over seeds 1 to 30 the run without mutation is behind the run with mutation at generations 200, 300 and 500 in all 30; the median gap after 500 generations is 168.6 %, against 15.0 % with it.
